- The Deputy Internal Ombudsman must be a retired or serving officer of a Regulated Entity (RE) at a rank equivalent to **Deputy General Manager** (or higher) in the RBI or another financial‑sector regulator [1].  
- The candidate must have **at least five years of experience** in banking, non‑banking finance, regulation, supervision, payment‑settlement systems, credit information or consumer‑protection [1].  
- The person **must not have been employed, nor be currently employed, by the bank or any of its holding, associate or subsidiary companies** [1].  
- The appointee **must be under 70 years of age** at the end of the tenure [1].
